# markdown-it 15.0.3

The browser file is the unmodified official npm archive UMD distribution; its original path and SHA256 are in manifest.json. It is served locally, without a runtime CDN or a build step.

The complete upstream license notices are preserved. The six package runtime dependency notices are also retained under licenses/ (including the CLI-only argparse notice). Versions are from the exact upstream 15.0.3 lock file; the browser source map lists the five bundled library dependencies.
